pairs: In summis excelsisque verticibus supra viam,
At the summits and the tops of exalted places, standing above the ways,
in the midst of the paths,
beside the gates of the city,
at the very doors, she speaks,
et vox mea ad filios hominum.
and my voice is to the sons of men.
quoniam de rebus magnis locutura sum,
for I will speak about great things,
et aperientur labia mea ut recta prædicent.
and my lips will be opened, so as to foretell what is right.
and my lips shall detest the impious.
non est in eis pravum quid,
There is no depravity in them,
They are upright to those who understand,
and equitable to those who discover knowledge.
Choose the doctrine that is greater than gold.
melior est enim sapientia cunctis pretiosissimis,
For wisdom is better than all that is most precious,
et omne desiderabile ei non potest comparari.
and everything that is desirable cannot compare to her.
and I am inside learned thoughts.
The fear of the Lord hates evil.
and a mouth with a double tongue.
kings reign and legislators decree just conditions.
princes rule and the powerful decree justice.
I love those who love me.
et qui mane vigilant ad me, invenient me.
And those who stand watch for me until morning shall discover me.
With me, are wealth and glory,
Melior est enim fructus meus auro et lapide pretioso,
For my fruit is better than gold and precious stones,
and my progeny better than choice silver.
I walk in the way of justice,
in the midst of the paths of judgment,
so that I may enrich those who love me,
Dominus possedit me in initio viarum suarum antequam quidquam faceret a principio.
The Lord possessed me in the beginning of his ways, before he made anything, from the beginning.
et ex antiquis antequam terra fieret.
and out of antiquity, before the earth was formed.
The abyss did not yet exist,
neither had the fountains of waters yet erupted.
The mountains, with their great mass, had not yet been established.
Before the hills, I was brought forth.
Still he had not made the earth,
and the poles of the globe of the earth.
I was already present: when he prepared the heavens;
quando certa lege et gyro vallabat abyssos;
when, with a certain law and a circuit, he fortified the abyss;
when he made firm the sky above,
and set free the fountains of waters;
when he encompassed the sea within its limits,
and laid down a law for the waters,
when he weighed the foundations of the earth.
I was with him in composing all things.
by playing in his sight at all times,
playing in globe of the earth.
et deliciæ meæ esse cum filiis hominum.
And my delight was to be with the sons of men.
Blessed are those who preserve my ways.
and do not be willing to cast it aside.
Blessed is the man who listens to me,
et qui vigilat ad fores meas quotidie,
and who stands watch at my gates every day,
et observat ad postes ostii mei.
and who observes at the posts of my doors.
and he will draw salvation from the Lord.
Qui autem in me peccaverit, lædet animam suam;
But he who sins against me will wound his own soul.
omnes qui me oderunt diligunt mortem.
All who hate me love death.”
